categories.abrasion: Scrape or graze: top layer of skin rubbed off (road rash, carpet burn from friction).
categories.laceration: Cut or tear through the skin (knife, glass, sharp edge).
categories.burn: Thermal burn from heat, hot liquid, steam, or a hot surface. Chemical/electrical burns are red flags.
categories.sprain: Twisted or rolled joint with pain or swelling, no sign of a break.
categories.bruise: Bump or bruise with intact skin.
categories.fracture: Possible broken bone: snap/crack sound, deformity, cannot bear weight.
categories.none: No supported injury identified (no injury visible, out of scope, or an emergency with no specific injury).
categories.unclear: An injury is mentioned but the type cannot be determined; ask a clarifying question.

red_flags.severe_bleeding: Bleeding that won't stop with pressure, spurting, soaking through.
red_flags.deep_wound: Gaping wound, can see fat/muscle/bone, stab or puncture wound.
red_flags.bone_exposed: Bone visible or poking through the skin.
red_flags.deformity: Limb bent at a wrong angle.
red_flags.numb_or_cold_limb: Limb numb, cold, pale, or blue below the injury.
red_flags.large_burn: Burn larger than the person's palm, or blistered over a large area.
red_flags.sensitive_area_burn: Burn on the face, eyes, mouth, hands, feet, genitals, or across a joint.
red_flags.head_injury: Hit to the head with confusion, vomiting, drowsiness, or memory loss.

output_schema.also: list of other categories mentioned (most urgent first), may be empty
output_schema.emergency: true if any red flag is present
output_schema.red_flags: list of red_flags keys, may be empty
output_schema.body_part: short lowercase body part or null
output_schema.clarify: one short question to ask the user, or null
